cohort: Primiparous women aged 18 years or older from Taiwan, both with and without Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM), whose data was extracted from a national health insurance program between 2000 and 2015.
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) is associated with increased risks of adverse maternal and infant outcomes in primiparous women.
mod_finding: Women with GDM had a significantly higher risk of overall emergency caesarean section and were more likely to undergo emergency C-section for reasons such as fetal distress, uterine atony, obstructed labor, and umbilical cord prolapse.
